Rules.InvariantScript:
User().FullName & " - " & If(
    Find(".", Office365Users.MyProfile().Department) > 0,
    Left(Office365Users.MyProfile().Department, Find(".", Office365Users.MyProfile().Department) - 1),
    Office365Users.MyProfile().Department
)

Sort(
    Filter(colRevReqs,
        If(varReviewQueueMine, Status.Value = "Pending", Status.Value = "Pending"),
        Not(varReviewQueueMine) Or Not(IsEmpty(Filter(DG_Agency_Contact, Lower(Email) = Lower(User().Email))))
    ),
    Modified, SortOrder.Descending
)

If(
    IsBlank(varReviewProject),
    Filter(AVCentralDepositMediaItems, 1 = 2),
    Sort(
        Filter(AVCentralDepositMediaItems, ParentRequest = varReviewProject.RequestNumber),
        Modified, SortOrder.Descending
    )
)
If(IsBlank(ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber) Or ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber = "New archive", "— untitled —", ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber)

If(
    Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber)) And ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber <> "New archive"
    And Not(IsBlank(First(ThisItem.MediaType).Value))
    And Not(IsBlank(First(ThisItem.ContractCase).Value))
    And Not(ThisItem.AIVoiceover = "Yes"),
    "✓  Ready",
    "⚠  Incomplete"
)

If(
    Not(IsBlank(ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber)) And ThisItem.CD_MediaNumber <> "New archive"
    And Not(IsBlank(First(ThisItem.MediaType).Value))
    And Not(IsBlank(First(ThisItem.ContractCase).Value))
    And Not(ThisItem.AIVoiceover = "Yes"),
    RGBA(22, 128, 80, 1),
    RGBA(193, 40, 40, 1)
)
"Assignee(s)  —  approver is added on approval; add a co-assignee if needed"
"Select a request from the queue on the left to review it."
ForAll(varReviewProject.DG_Agency_Contact As p, {DisplayName: p.DisplayName, Mail: p.Email})
"Explain what needs to be corrected before the project can be approved."

If(
    Not(IsBlank(varReviewProject)) And Not(IsBlank(varReviewComment)) And varReviewComment <> "",
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)
"No internet connection detected. Please verify your connection and try again."
"A reviewer comment is required before rejecting."
